scope.description: P0-P2 repository, governance, versioned data contracts, typed I/O and deterministic runtime foundation; P3-P8 remain separately gated.

assumptions: HTSlib 1.18 from pkg-config is the local production-compatible dependency.
No historical Python scientific program is executed in LongLineage.
The current full co-occurrence authority is absent, so P4 cannot be marked VERIFIED.

step_verify.step: Validate governance, schemas and source boundaries.
step_verify.verify: scripts/ci/check_all.sh exits 0 and reports no real data, truth leakage or Python science.

step_verify.step: Build all C++ targets with the pinned local dependency contract.
step_verify.verify: /usr/bin/cmake configure and build exit 0 with HTSlib 1.18 and no warnings.

step_verify.step: Replay typed I/O, runtime and topology foundation tests.
step_verify.verify: CTest exits 0; malformed MM/ML, sidecar conflicts, worker failure and incomplete-winner cases are rejected.

step_verify.step: Publish only the verified foundation to the private repository.
step_verify.verify: Remote visibility is private and phase ledger retains P3-P8 blockers.

evidence.output_excerpt: AUDIT SOURCE PASS: 197 Git blobs; Debug, Release and ASan/UBSan CTest 25/25; Debug/Release FOUNDATION_PASS.

deviations: The default PATH cmake is 3.14.4; documented commands use /usr/bin/cmake 3.22.1.

/usr/bin/jsonschema is 3.2.0 and falls back to Draft 7 for 2020-12 meta-schema URIs; current contracts use compatible keywords and pass exercised fixtures, but the validator must be pinned before release verification.

Three bootstrap subagents started before the machine lease/write-set registry existed. Their historical writes have no per-agent task record and no lease is retroactively fabricated; all delegation after policy activation must register a non-overlapping child claim before writing.

The first sanitizer replay omitted the sandbox-specific LeakSanitizer exception and was stopped as invalid environment evidence. The complete replay kept AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer active while setting ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0.
